thread:
Jesse: Hey team — need a small visual pack for the strategy-led launch next week. Scope: 1x benchmark one-pager (A4), 1x webinar hero (1200x628), 3x social cards (square), and 2x speaker slide templates. Limited run: quick variants only (brand-safe, mobile-first). Deadline: Tue 03/02 EOD. Can creative ops triage?

Kai: Ack. Can you confirm priority order? Also do we have the benchmark numbers finalized or placeholders?

Anna: Prioritize one-pager + hero first. Social cards can be lighter. Need to know CTA and URL for the hero.

Jesse: Priority = 1) one-pager 2) hero 3) socials 4) slides. CTA -> "Register" linking to https://redwood.run/webinar-reg. Bench numbers: use latest CSV in the doc (link below) — final sign-off by product tomorrow morning.

Rachel: Brand notes — avoid heavy gradients, stick to primary palette, use clear logo lockup, keep 24px safe margin around hero crop. Do not alter the logotype. Use the following tokens:
```
Primary: #0A6EFF
Accent: #00C2A1
Neutral/Dark: #0F1720
Type: Inter var (400/600)
```

Kai: Will mock three visual directions tonight and share Figma file. Question on tone: should benchmark one-pager be technical (latency/cost tables) or narrative (summary + highlight metrics)?

Mike: Make the one-pager narrative-forward but include a small table (2 rows) with the core latency vs cost numbers. We can attach a separate CSV for people who want raw metrics.

Anna: Also need two localization variants (FR, DE) for the hero and one social card. Keep copy short for translations.

Jesse: Good call on localization. I'll drop translated copy in the doc by EOD.

Kai: Quick checklist for design ops: 1) filename conventions (see below) 2) mobile cropping guides 3) export presets (PNG 72dpi for socials, PDF 300dpi for one-pager)

Kai: Proposed filenames:
- redwood_bench_onepager_v1.pdf
- redwood_webinar_hero_register_1200x628_v1.png
- redwood_social_card_01_v1.png

Rachel: Tagging brand for a fast pre-approve: @Rachel — can you give the go/no-go on the three directions once Kai posts? If anything's off, call it now so we don't rework.

Rachel: Quick: ok to use subtle drop shadow on cards but keep it < 6% opacity. No neon glows.

DesignBot: New creative request created: CR-2345 assigned to Kai. ETA on board: 48h.

Kai: Sharing Figma link shortly — will include three directions and a simplified spec page (colors, spacing, fonts).

Anna: If timeline slips, we should at least ship hero + one-pager first and hold socials. Also can product help with a short quote for the hero header?

Mike: I'll give a 1-line quote from PM by noon. Speaker photos: Jesse, can you collect high-res headshots and speaker bios?

Jesse: Collecting photos now. Uploaded one draft of the one-pager data sheet here: https://docs.redwood.ai/bench-draft.

Kai: Cool — I'll start artboarding. Will ping when first frames are up.

Anna: Thanks — please add a Slack thread update when hero is ready so growth can draft copy for the registration flow.

Jesse: Thanks everyone. Rapid: if brand signs off quickly we can demo internally on Wed.

Rachel: Noted — will review as soon as Figma appears.

DesignBot: CR-2345 status updated: In design (Kai).
